create_inference_batcher: create an InferenceBatcher instance with a predict unit and max batch size for MLIP inference
use_inference_batcher_context_manager: use InferenceBatcher as a context manager to batch inference requests with automatic cleanup
shutdown_inference_batcher: shutdown the InferenceBatcher executor and wait for pending tasks to complete
get_batch_predict_unit: get the BatchServerPredictUnit from an InferenceBatcher for batched prediction
get_concurrency_backend: get a thread pool concurrency backend executor for running ASE calculations concurrently
